title: Desktop library, project, preferences, Claude, Codex and API provider IPC exchange
description: Contract documentation envelope for a native IPC request and response. Electron channel and request are separate arguments at runtime; absent payload represents undefined, never null. No source filesystem path crosses this boundary. Runtime also validates trusted main-frame sender and source-specific seek bounds.

value.description: Runtime additionally rejects duplicate IDs even if the other summary fields differ.
Runtime additionally rejects duplicate project IDs even when other view fields differ.

frame.description: Runtime additionally checks width * height <= 16777216, exact base64 length 4 * ceil(width * height * 4 / 3), and padding for the byte count. JSON Schema alone does not establish decoded frame equality.

projectRequest.description: For projects:create, id is an imported media ID. For projects:open, id is a project ID. Paths are never accepted.

twoSourceProjectRequest.description: Ordered, distinct managed library IDs. Runtime rejects duplicates and does not accept filesystem paths.

transcriptionProjectRequest.description: Main binds local analysis to this active project and its verified immutable sources. No source path is accepted.

transcriptionJobRequest.description: Polling repeats the same job ID after a request timeout; null asks for the current or cached project state.

manualTranscriptCorrectionRequest.description: Manual text-only correction bound to one existing local transcript word and the exact committed draft head. Main verifies source/transcript/word identity and the effective prior text before committing through the shared history.

manualTranscriptCutRequest.description: Manual transcript-linked ripple cut bound to one path-free local source/transcript word range and the exact committed draft head. Main validates identity, order and one continuous visible clip mapping, then commits exact source/output times through the shared history.

sources.description: Present only for a two-source project, in timeline order. Runtime requires source to equal the first item and IDs to be distinct.

clips.description: Optional for older exchange fixtures. Runtime emits exact ordered committed clips and matches their source IDs to source or sources.

transcriptEdits.description: Optional for older exchange fixtures. Text-only corrections in the shared draft history; recorded audio remains unchanged.

projectView.description: Path-free committed project and draft view. Runtime additionally requires project, revision, draft, source and timeline IDs to be distinct, an ordered two-source inventory when present, and draft.baseRevisionId to equal revisionId. A stage identifies navigation, not successful feature execution or export.

codexView.description: Main-owned account settings summary. Runtime additionally rejects duplicate model IDs and requires each default reasoning to exist in its model catalog. Unknown account state is not signed out. Login URL, login ID, email, credentials, paths and generic RPC are forbidden. Model selection is persisted only after runtime catalog validation.

retryable.description: True only after the authoritative server marks the active Codex turn failed; it permits an explicit user retry of the last submitted request.

projectClipView.description: Half-open committed clip map; runtime additionally validates ordered source identity, contiguity, positive equal source/timeline spans, and total duration.

projectDraftView.description: Path-free current draft identity and timeline. Runtime requires distinct project, base revision, draft, and timeline IDs.

manualTrimRequest.description: Renderer sends intent and freshness. Main injects request, pass and operation IDs, origin, and reason.

manualSplitRequest.description: Renderer sends split intent and freshness. Main injects transaction, pass and operation IDs and manual origin.

manualRangeCutRequest.description: Renderer sends an output-timeline half-open range and committed head. Main injects trusted manual authority.

manualRestoreRangeRequest.description: Renderer sends one exact missing half-open source-time interval and committed head. Runtime additionally requires sourceStartUs < sourceEndUs; main resolves the immutable baseline and injects manual authority.

manualUndoRequest.description: Undo only the committed head transaction. Main supplies a fresh request ID and reason.

projectFrameRequest.description: Binds a project-timeline frame request to the exact committed draft head. No source identity, source time, or path crosses the renderer boundary.

claudeView.description: Credential-free Claude connection state. Sign-in runs in the user's unmodified Claude Code CLI; no token, email, path or price is exposed.
